sociālis

sociālis, sociāle

Declension on Wiktionary

social, made for fellowship

In this lexicon

  • social

    the recommended word · classical · Sen. Clem. 1.3.2: hominem sociāle animal commūnī bonō genitum; Sen. Ben. 5.11.5: beneficium dare sociālis rēs est; Sen. Ben. 7.1.7

  • īnstrūmenta commūnicātiōnis sociālis: media

    modern
